name: ProgressNoteDocumentTypeCode
title: ProgressNoteDocumentTypeCode
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
description:
Run a Search.loinc query for (Component: Progress note Scale: Doc). From the export, create a comma-separated list of codes. Add the comma-separated list to the definition with Operator "in" to the "Code" field.
AND as an additional OR clause "Property" = "Concept" ,  "Operator"= "in" = 57055-6
purpose:
(Clinical Focus: Progress note kind classified by setting, author role, and author specialization),(Data Element Scope: Represents notes that summarize a patient’s status and progress towards goals and, care updates, during an episode of care.),(Inclusion Criteria: LOINC document concepts representing a progress note where component = 'progress note' and scale = 'DOC),(Exclusion Criteria: LOINC document codes Notes specific to another defined type (e.g., operative, procedure, discharge).
Non-clinical or administrative notes.)
